content.text:
I moved `incrementNodeInspectorPort` and `useColor` out of `lib/command.js` into a new `lib/utils.js`, which exports both. Both are copied over unchanged except for two small edits. `incrementNodeInspectorPort` gained `export`, since it was module-private before. The `useColor` doc comment now says it is "Exported for using from tests and command.js."

`lib/command.js` now imports both from `./utils.js`, and `tests/useColor.test.js` imports `useColor` from `../lib/utils.js`. `npm run check:type:js` passes. `node --test` passes: 1372 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped. No other file referenced either function. `lib/utils.js` is already covered by the `lib/*.js` entry in `package.json`'s `files`.
